html:
Ask five Taylors homeowners what a good cleaning looks like and you will hear the same complaint about the last service they tried: the middle of the room was perfect and the edges were not. Brazilian house cleaning is built around that gap. It is the method Perfect Services uses in every home, and it comes down to one habit: clean the places most people skip, and do it by hand.

The short definition, and what the team does differently

Brazilian house cleaning is a detail-first approach where each room is worked from its edges toward its center, surfaces are wiped by hand, and the team checks the room against a written list before moving on. It is not a special product or a secret formula. It is order, patience and attention to small spots.

  • Corners, edges and baseboards are cleaned by hand, not just reached with a vacuum attachment.
  • Small furniture and items are moved, cleaned under and returned to place.
  • Door frames, switches and handles get their own pass.
  • Bathrooms include grout and the base of the toilet.
  • Kitchens are degreased: stovetop, range hood and cabinet fronts.
  • Floors are hand-washed along the walls, where mops usually leave a gray line.
  • A final walk-through compares every room to the checklist.

Our full description lives on the Brazilian house cleaning service page.

Taylors homes and what they ask for

Taylors is a Greenville County community of established neighborhoods and family homes, centered on the revitalized Taylors Mill area, with US-29 (Wade Hampton Blvd) and SC-290 running through it. In homes of this kind, we often see families with kids and pets, hardwood in the living areas, and kitchens that get used every night. Those are the rooms where a hand-detail method pays off: pet hair collects along baseboards, cooking film sits on cabinet fronts and handles, and hardwood needs washing that respects the finish.

You can see how we apply it locally on the page for Brazilian house cleaning in Taylors. The 29687 ZIP code is about 4 miles west of Greer and a 10-minute drive, so scheduling is flexible.

The order we work in

  1. Walkthrough with you, noting anything fragile or off limits.
  2. Bathrooms first, so products can sit while we work elsewhere.
  3. Kitchen, starting with the stovetop and hood so grease does not drip onto a finished counter.
  4. Dusting from high to low through the living areas and bedrooms.
  5. Floors last, ending at the door.
  6. Checklist inspection before we leave.

The answer depends on home size (rooms and square feet), the level of detail you want, how often we come, the number of bathrooms and the condition of the home. Recurring visits cost less per visit, and a first visit usually takes longer.

We never give a price over the phone or from photos. Perfect Services gives an exact price after a free in-home estimate, which is a short visit with no commitment. Call (864) 399-5168, text (864) 666-8520, or use the form on the Taylors booking page. Most walkthroughs are quick and can often be arranged this week. You can also start from our estimate request on the home page.

Who it is for, and when to start

Start by looking at your own home for the clues. Dust lines along baseboards, gray edges on floors, sticky cabinet handles, grout that never looks quite clean after a mop: these are the signs that a hurried method has been used. Many Taylors families tell us they simply want the same standard every time, without having to point out the same corner twice. That consistency is the real selling point, and it comes from the room checklist rather than from any single cleaner. People who tend to choose this method are homeowners disappointed by rushed services, families who want the corners done on every visit, and owners of homes with hardwood, tile and grout. If your house has not had a thorough clean in a while, a deep cleaning first can make recurring visits easier to keep up. Families with pets may also like green cleaning for product choice.

Taylors sits close to several neighbors. Homeowners in the Wade Hampton area can read about Brazilian cleaning in Wade Hampton. For a different angle on the method, see our article on Brazilian cleaning for renters in Greer.

One practical tip for new clients: before the visit, clear the counters and pick up loose items from floors, so the team can spend its hours on cleaning instead of tidying. You do not need to scrub beforehand or hide anything. We see lived-in homes every day, and the aim of the first visit is to get the house to a standard that recurring visits can then hold. If you have pets, mention where they sleep and eat, since those spots collect hair and need a little extra time. For homes with small children, tell us about any rooms you would like left alone during nap time.

If you want to see the difference in your own kitchen and baseboards, request your free in-home estimate in Taylors. The Taylors service page lists everything included in a visit.
faqs: Why is it called Brazilian house cleaning?
It reflects the detail-first habits many Brazilian families use at home and that our Brazilian-owned team brings to work: hand-wiped surfaces, edges first and nothing skipped.
Is the first visit different from later ones?
Yes. The first visit usually takes longer because it brings the home to a detailed standard. Recurring visits then maintain it and cost less per visit.
